description: Cambridgeshire Railway Usage Estimates is a dataset listed in UK national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Cambridgeshire Insight. A selection of csv files breaking down rail usage estimates across Cambridgeshire and Peterborough. The Office of Rail and Road (ORR) produces yearly (April-March) estimates of the total number of entries, exits and interchanges at rail stations in Great Britain. The estimates are based on ticket sales data recorded in rail industry systems. Coverage: Cambridgeshire Insight. The portal files it under the publisher Cambridgeshire Insight. Its tags are rail, transport. It offers 6 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON. The portal shows 2025-04-02 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support rail network and station studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-uk-portal.
